technical.summary: Strong bullish structure (price above all major MAs, golden cross, three white soldiers, volume spike) undermined by overbought short-term conditions and weak trend strength; suitable for scaled entry with tight stops, not aggressive accumulation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (374.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event 42 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + golden cross + 15x volume spike create textbook bullish structure with price holding above major moving averages, offering a contrarian entry in extreme fear conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI (70.69) and stochastic (84.56), weak ADX (16.96), absent systematic entry signal, zero fundamental catalysts, elevated earnings risk in 42 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising dollar, recession yield curve) create asymmetric downside risk.
